executive_summary: Maven compilation failed with 2 errors after dependency issues were resolved. TaskController has a method signature mismatch when calling getUserTasks (passing int parameters instead of Pageable). TaskStatus enum incorrectly attempts to override the final name() method from java.lang.Enum. Both require code-level fixes.

errors.message: method getUserTasks cannot be applied to given types; required: Long,Pageable found: Long,int,int
errors.root_cause: TaskController.getUserTasks() is calling taskService.getUserTasks(userId, page, size) with two int parameters, but the service interface expects getUserTasks(Long userId, Pageable pageable). The controller must create a Pageable object instead of passing raw page and size integers.
errors.fix_recommendation: In TaskController.java line 45, replace the method call with: taskService.getUserTasks(userId, PageRequest.of(page, size)). Add import: import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;

errors.message: name() in TaskStatus cannot override name() in java.lang.Enum; overridden method is final
errors.root_cause: TaskStatus enum is attempting to override the final name() method inherited from java.lang.Enum. The name() method in Enum is final and cannot be overridden. If custom naming is needed, use a different method name or add a custom field.
errors.fix_recommendation: Remove the name() method override from TaskStatus.java. If custom display names are needed, add a private String field (e.g., 'displayName') with a getter method instead of overriding name().
